name: Squat Thruster
instructions: Hold dumbbells at your shoulders and stand with feet shoulder-width.
Squat down with your chest tall.
Press the dumbbells overhead as you stand.
Lower them back to your shoulders.
longevityNotes: Squatting is the foundation of getting up, sitting down, and climbing stairs. Keeping leg strength and knee range preserves independence decades longer than any single other movement.
overview: A front squat that flows into an overhead press for full-body conditioning.
